annotations.title: Check a Shopify product import CSV

description: Free. Checks a Shopify product import CSV for the problems that make imports fail or silently go wrong (wrong encoding, Excel-damaged barcodes, missing handles, option mistakes, prices with $ signs, broken quoting, duplicate variants) and returns each failed rule with row numbers. Use it before importing products into Shopify or when a Shopify import errors. Pass the CSV text, or a public URL to it.

csv_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the CSV, if csv_text is not given.
